level.name: Bend the run
level.brief: Four players. Their high line holds. The 11 runs along it to stay onside, then bends in behind.

att.name: Centre-back
att.tip: You are being hunted. Play it short to the 6 straight away.

att.name: Pivot
att.tip: The screen blocks the wide ball. Play it across into the 10 as he comes off his marker.

att.name: Number ten
att.tip: Come off your marker to meet it. Aim early and slide it first time between the centre-halves.

att.name: Right winger
att.tip: Run across along their line to stay onside. Bend in behind as the 10 plays it, and finish.
